title: Intangible Assets
intro: الأصل غير الملموس: أصل **قابل للتحديد**، غير نقدي، **بدون وجود مادي**.
مرحلة **البحث** دائماً مصروف. مرحلة **التطوير** تُرسمل فقط لو كل الشروط اتحققت.
العمر المحدد ← استهلاك (amortisation). العمر غير المحدد ← لا استهلاك واختبار هبوط سنوي.

tf.s: Internally generated goodwill is recognised as an asset.
tf.why: It is not identifiable and its cost cannot be measured reliably.

tf.s: Expenditure on training activities is recognised as an expense.
tf.why: Training does not create a controlled asset.

tf.s: Advertising and promotional costs are expensed when incurred.
tf.why: They build the business as a whole, not an identifiable asset.

tf.s: If the research and development phases cannot be distinguished, all expenditure is treated as research.
An intangible with an indefinite useful life is amortised over 20 years.
tf.why: It is not amortised; it is tested for impairment annually.

tf.s: Start-up costs are capitalised as intangible assets.

fill.s: An intangible asset is an identifiable non-monetary asset without physical ___.
Intangibles with indefinite lives are tested for ___ at least annually.
The revaluation model for intangibles needs an ___ market.
